title: Feed the Beast
sub: Even though we give it our all for you and try to keep making music, it all comes at a cost. There are various ways you can support us. You can either become a patron and support us with 5.- a month. As a patron, you’ll enjoy a number of benefits, such as a better insight into our band, access to the party or gig at the end of the month and more...

cards.heading: Become a Patron
cards.blurb: Support your local band. Help us play as many gigs as possible. We need support to cover our rent, travel costs, equipment, the photographer, the videographer, etc. If you can spare 5 CHF a month, we’ll play even louder just for you.
bullets: End of the Month Party - FREE

cards.heading: Sponsor a Show
cards.blurb:
Help make live music possible!

Through your sponsorship, you’ll be supporting unforgettable events and helping to make high-quality live performances a reality. Whether you’re a business or an individual, every contribution helps ensure artists are paid fairly and creates unique experiences for the audience.
bullets: <Brand presence> : Visibility on our website, social media and at live events.
